snippet.title: CAPTCHA Hell | Gameplay Teaser
snippet.description:
Wishlist CAPTCHA Hell on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4310270/CAPTCHA_Hell/

CAPTCHA Hell is a pixel art adventure puzzle game where you are just trying to buy a concert ticket, but the CAPTCHAs have other plans.

Your favorite idol singer Nova Hoshimiya is retiring at the height of her fame, and her farewell concert is your last chance to see her perform. The tickets are selling fast, so you rush to the ticket website… only to be hit by an endless wave of CAPTCHAs. What started as a simple ticket purchase is turning into something much stranger. Navigate your computer desktop, uncover the deeper mystery behind the unhinged verification challenges, and fight your way to a ticket before they sell out!

#CAPTCHAHell #indiegame
